diagnosis.micro: UAOS correctly diagnosed that Financial proactive-resolution was mostly rule/static-test evidence, then initially ended the audit by recommending a future executable bridge instead of executing the currently available governed repair.
diagnosis.macro: Problem detection, deliberation, recovery-before-user-escalation and observable-inheritance assurance were present, but there was no terminal admission rule requiring a detected repairable problem to move from cognition into current action.
diagnosis.assumption_challenged: A strong diagnosis plus a concrete recommendation is sufficient problem closure when the acting Agent already has authority and tools to repair the defect.

external_method_evidence: Kubernetes admission controllers make policy effective by intercepting an operation before persistence instead of relying on policy text alone.
Pact contract testing verifies executable interactions against a contract rather than treating the declaration itself as behavioral proof.

alternatives.failure_mode: Repeats the declaration-to-operation defect; the Agent can still stop at recommendation-only.
Overreaches authority, user-choice and safety boundaries and would make read-only diagnosis unsafe.

Does not physically intercept every natural-language host response, but it makes valid terminal states executable/testable and lets domains attach stronger receipts/probes without transferring business ownership to UAOS.

implemented_parent_changes: Added src/uaos/kernel/problem_closure.py with CLEAN_NO_PROBLEM, REPAIR_NOW, REPAIR_EXECUTED, BLOCKED_WITH_REASON and NO_CHANGE_WITH_EVIDENCE decisions plus finalization admission.
SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY 1.7 requires the problem-to-action closure gate before final response/maintenance closure.
COMMON_BEHAVIOR_ASSURANCE 1.2 promotes PROBLEM_TO_ACTION_CLOSURE_GAP common semantics and preserves the host-level physical-enforcement limitation.
BINDING_POLICY requires registered-domain operational adoption to use owner-native execution evidence where supported.
ENTRYPOINT and CURRENT_SYSTEM expose repair-or-block semantics and forbid recommendation-only closure for currently repairable problems.
implemented_financial_realization: Financial 0.9.2 / profile17 added financial_writing_agent/proactive_resolution.py with owner-state recovery attempts and financial_owner_proactive_resolution_admission execution receipts.

require_user_escalation_admission denies externalization when no recovery attempt exists or when a safe RESOLVED/PROVISIONAL path exists; non-explicit escalation requires an unsafe UNRESOLVED attempt with concrete blockers/unknowns.

The behavior trajectory reproduces the original voice failure: no canonical approved full article -> inspect durable corrections/edited outputs/current context -> create a medium-confidence provisional voice candidate -> continue rather than ask the user.
Financial maintenance mirrors, static audit, contract eval, capability profile, Skill and causal Journal/Index/Handoff were updated without adding a second controller.
Financial machine evidence was made event-scoped so current UAOS parent observation remains parent-owned external evidence rather than a self-invalidating child latest/pending field.

repair_history.repair: Advance stale consumers; do not weaken the new contract.

repair_history.cause: A newly added test overfit exact prose 'must be attempted' while the policy used semantically equivalent 'must attempt the repair'.
repair_history.repair: Assert behavior-bearing semantics rather than forcing production wording.

repair_history.cause: Two old tests still expected Financial 0.9.1/Profile16 and UAOS_SKILL exceeded the existing 8KB startup budget by 276 bytes.
repair_history.repair: Advance stale version/profile assertions and compress the Skill while keeping detail in progressive references/code; do not relax the startup budget.

repair_history.symptom: The current child index encoded PARENT_OBSERVATION_REFRESH_PENDING even though parent-current observation is UAOS-owned and would change immediately after the parent refresh.
repair_history.repair: Remove the moving parent-current status from the child machine index; keep event-specific child promotion receipts and make current parent observation explicitly UAOS-owned external evidence.

assurance_boundary: The repair is executable-policy and trajectory verified. UAOS baseline still does not claim physical interception of every natural-language host response, and Financial does not claim LIVE_OUTCOME_VERIFIED until real article use validates the behavior.
remaining_observation: Validate Financial proactive-resolution receipts/escalation admission on real article work, especially provisional voice inference.
Refine or roll back if live use causes unsupported user-preference inference, unnecessary durable logging, or avoidable user escalation.
Other domains adopt owner-native evidence only when their execution topology supports the common behavior; do not copy Financial's Python/state shape mechanically.
